modification: Reformatted the upstream file from tab indentation to two-space indentation, added a top-level _notice field and per-rule comment strings, and added the rules below; no baseline syscall rule was removed or reordered, and archMap lost the SCMP_ARCH_S390X entry because the new clone rules cannot be expressed for its parameter ordering. Added CLONE_NEWUSER-filtered clone() and unshare() allow rules for namespace bootstrap. Added a CLONE_FS-filtered clone() rule for the Chromium zygote helper Credentials::ChrootToSafeEmptyDir(). Added a CLONE_NEWPID-filtered clone() rule for NamespaceSandbox::ForkInNewPidNamespace() when spawning renderers. Kept the upstream clone3 ENOSYS rule without kernel/architecture narrowing so glibc always falls back to the filtered clone(). Added unconditional mount, umount2 and chroot allow rules because the mandatory --cap-drop ALL deployment drops capability-gated baseline rules; the namespace root is confined to Chromium's new user namespace.
